c34d7ad Another bug fix
754e965 Fixed bug in last commit
d37442c Fixes #319
1adb5fc Fixes #320
21f3c0b Overhauled the way we handle screen size, fixing the infamous resize-related crash in the process.
993c862 Reconnecting artifacts
a7c4f19 More accurate block selection based on height
cc32a25 Merge pull request #310 from SoniEx2/master
84bf151 Fix for fog bug in last commit
4b56c65 Added height/name offset for models
7c371cb Fix/Feature for noclip block rendering
9f682a7 Refactor Minecraft.getMinecraftDirectory()
91ec461 Revert "Fixed third person mode ability being affected by NoClip hack control flag."
574e047 Slight cleanup in HUDScreen
6c3d9af A few small performance improvements here and there: - Don't update level-loading progress bar more than 20 times per sec (slight load time improvement for large maps) - Don't concat strings in ChatInputScreen -- saves many thousands of temp string allocations per second. - Stop using non-generic collection for particles. This may be further improved by Deque, since there's a lot of out-of-order element removal going on. - Remove needless bitwise-AND in Level.getTile - Replace obsoleted Vector<T> with ArrayList<T> for chat log.
c00822b Finished EmoteFix support by not trimming emotes (i.e. control characters) from beginning and end of incoming messages. Also moved enabled-CPE-extension-tracking code from PacketHandler to NetworkManager. And fixed a misplaced "Server attempted to use unsupported extension" warning in PacketHandler, for EXT_REMOVE_PLAYER_NAME.
3e7eb84 Fixed animation problems with custom texture packs. Fixed HD fonts not getting scaled/spaced properly. Removed unused imports.
d53e139 Rewrote TextureManager.load() for better readability/reliability/performance. Fixed texture pack loading. Fixed letter spacing in custom fonts.
3f567a5 Working on a fix for texture pack loading. Also fixed singleplayer not launching properly, and fixed EXT_ADD_PLAYER_NAME throwing warnings.
098049d Fixed hover-names.
12c894b Implemented ExtPlayerList v2
e293f5c Several more ChangeModel related fixes and improvements. NOTE: got rid of ability to render humanoid mobs with armor, which was apparently possible in survivaltest. Or something. Known issue: sheep fur does not render properly.
2d1a77f Fixed changing texture pack unloading players' skins. Added constants for all mob texture names. Fixed SkinDownloadThread not logging errors properly. A few smaller fixes.
25949ed Overhauled ChangeModel implementation. Player and NetworkPlayer now both derive from HumanoidMob, which has the new functions for changing models and skins.
6553c29 Changing texture pack no longer resets map's side/edge textures to default block types. Now they merely change texture.
8af8dc3 Fixed smoothing and anisotropy settings not taking immediate effect.
9e875ea Changed most texture name strings (e.g. load("/gui/gui.png")) with constants (e.g. load(Textures.GUI)).
9c3fba5 Fixed third person mode ability being affected by NoClip hack control flag.
443fa45 Fixed packetHandler.isLoadingLevel not starting off as "true" (fixes client sending teleport packets too soon). Also fixed vsync on/off spam in console.
8dff80d Fixed a NullPointerException in PacketHandler if ENV_SET_COLOR is received before LEVEL_FINALIZE. Also fixed countdown on the [Try to reconnect] button being framerate-dependent.
323eb42 Assorted cleanup and optimization. Slightly increased lava fog density (accidentally reduced in last patch). Disabled some survival-mode overhead when not in survival mode. Made vsync adaptive (only on if fps >= desiredFramerate/2).
4bd3a90 Fixed "Reconnect" button not resetting the netcode properly.
d5ea4c4 Re-organized WoM-config related code. Fixed client not sending /womid to requesting servers.
2713605 Re-organized netcode a bit: merged NetworkHandler with NetworkManager.
ce5d511 Cleanup and commenting in PacketHandler and ProtocolExtension classes.
f17f52f Cleaned up movement code in Entity and Player. Introduced ThirdPersonMode enum, to replace int.
7dd6b21 Fixed a build error introduced in previous commit.
8b39aca Fixed single-player flicker caused by previous commit.
06c3850 Attempting a fix for loading-screen flicker. Singleplayer is currently broken (no idea why).
cc7b3c6 Introduced flexible "framerate limit" setting.
60cc94f Changed the algorithm responsible for dynamic chunk updates to be based on actual FPS, instead of estimated vsync idle time. Works more reliably.
0883784 Reworked chunk update limiting and fog.
5cf03c8 Added scrollable chat
29b9b60 Added UnsatisfiedLinkError to list of throwables that Minecraft.run checks for, on initialization.
cb50ebe Fixed client freezing if LWJGL could not be found. An error dialog is now shown, and client then cleanly shuts down.
64bbaac Merge pull request #281 from Raynexx/master
92d579a Updated client to support the latest source
423e913 Merge branch 'master' of github.com:andrewphorn/ClassiCube-Client
2d3765b Fixed #266 Chunks now unload beyond render distance
196b41b Made support for CPE Messagetypes proper

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: d37442cdb1189c7202c177901832e34f582e2fe

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of the exact line modified in the fix commit (`if (!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel...) pause(); else Mouse.setGrabbed(false);`) using `git log -p -S"isLoadingLevel"` on `Minecraft.java`. This showed the condition `if (!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel){ pause(); } else { Mouse.setGrabbed(false); }` was first introduced in commit `d37442c` ("Fixes #319"), replacing a previously unconditional `pause();` call. I then checked how `packetHandler.isLoadingLevel` is initialized and toggled (`PacketHandler.java`) and how singleplayer mode is started (`Minecraft.restartSinglePlayer()`).

**(2) The specific change:** `PacketHandler`'s constructor sets `isLoadingLevel = true` by default, and this flag is only ever set back to `false` inside `PacketHandler.handlePacket()` — i.e., only when actual network packets (like `LEVEL_FINALIZE`) are processed. In singleplayer, `restartSinglePlayer()` builds/loads the level directly and never touches `packetHandler` or calls `handlePacket()`, so `isLoadingLevel` remains `true` for the entire singleplayer session. Commit `d37442c` gated the ESC-key `pause()` call behind `!packetHandler.isLoadingLevel`, which — for singleplayer — is always false, so pressing ESC could never open the pause/options menu in singleplayer. Before this commit, `pause()` was called unconditionally, so the menu worked fine in both modes.

**(3) Evidence:**
- `PacketHandler.java:55` — constructor calls `setLoadingLevel(true)`.
- `PacketHandler.java:166,297` — the only places `setLoadingLevel(false)` is called, both inside packet-handling logic that never executes in singleplayer.
- `Minecraft.java:2104-2121` (`restartSinglePlayer`) — no reference to `packetHandler`/`isLoadingLevel` at all.
- The fix in `c34d7ad` adds `|| !isOnline()` to the exact condition introduced by `d37442c`, which is the textbook way to patch "this flag is only meaningful when online."

The follow-up commit `754e965` ("Fixed bug in last commit") only touched a different code block (line ~1802, the "ignore all keyboard input while loading" section), not the line ultimately fixed in `c34d7ad`, so it is not responsible for this particular bug.

I'm confident in this attribution given the direct data-flow trace from flag initialization to the exact conditional that was patched.
